listing.name: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier — GRFS-Recomp (alex-stampede)
listing.original_game_title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier
listing.summary: Upstream reports Campaign and Guerrilla gameplay on development Macs with M-series chips. Visual bugs remain. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier Xbox 360 disc ISO. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Install the Mac package and import your own compatible ISO using upstream’s instructions. The selected binary requires macOS 27 and is ad hoc signed.

warnings: Upstream reports Campaign and Guerrilla gameplay on development Macs with M-series chips. Visual bugs remain.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
